title: Famous Places Around the World
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall and made of iron. Many people visit it every year. You can climb the stairs or take a lift.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long and old. People walk on the top of the wall. It is a famous place for tourists.

questions.text: Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: It is a very tall and popular place
It is small and hard to see

questions.text: What can we say about the Great Wall?
options: It is a place many tourists enjoy

vocabulary.definition: having a large height from bottom to top
a strong metal used to make things
people who travel to visit other places

paragraph_translations: Eyfel Kulesi Paris'tedir. Cok uzundur ve demirden yapilmistir. Her yil bircok insan onu ziyaret eder. Merdivenlerden cikabilir veya asansore binebilirsiniz.
Buyuk Cin Seti Cin'dedir. Cok uzun ve eskidir. Insanlar setin ustunde yurur. Turistler icin unlu bir yerdir.
